title: XamlGen Output Envelope
description: Output envelope returned by the XAML generator. Contains generated XAML outputs, effective policy, resolved sources, optional input provenance, and diagnostics.

schemaVersion.description: Integer encoded as string. Increment on breaking changes.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of this generator call. ISO 8601.

expressionLanguage.description: Expression language used during generation. Echoed from the input document for observability.

catalogSchemaVersion.description: Activity-catalog schema version the generator validated and consumed. Matches the generator's SUPPORTED_CATALOG_SCHEMA_VERSION constant. Consumers can use this to detect generator/catalog version skew.

outputs.description: Generated XAML outputs. null when status is Failed. Fragment mode: one entry with name=null. Full-file mode: one entry per workflow.

effectivePolicy.description: Full merged policy object actually applied. Always the complete resolved state — built-in defaults overlaid with any caller overrides.

resolvedSources.description: Activity-catalog files actually consulted during this generation run. Sourced from catalog.source.id and catalog.source.version.

inputProvenance.description: null when verbose=False (default). Populated with per-activity resolution trace when verbose=True.

diagnostics.description: Generation diagnostics. Empty array when none.

name.description: Workflow name (matches workflows[].name from input). null in fragment mode.

xaml.description: Generated XAML string. Complete <Activity x:Class="..."> document in full-file mode; unwrapped element in fragment mode.

resolvedVersion.description: Exact resolved version actually used (catalog source.version).

activityId.description: Activity-catalog activity id as provided in the input AST.
